title: Visit to Chicago in 1922
summary: In 1922 he spent 60 days in Chicago on vacation without playing, meeting Richard M. Jones, Oliver and Freddie Keppard.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: And then when I was in Chicago and I met Oliver and I met Frederick Kepard and I met a gang of them. When did you go to Chicago? In 22. Did you stay long? I stayed 60 days, that's all.
Did you work much as a musician or just not too busy?

No I was just you know on a vacation like, on a pleasure trip like, you see what I mean? So I went to Chicago and stayed there 60 days and I come on back home and went back to work. I didn't play no music you know. Well we had a piano where we were living and that's why I met Manny Jones. Oh yes. And he says what you gonna do, you gonna stay around Chicago? I says no I'm going back home. I'm going back home to go to work.
What trade did you follow by the way?
